capabilities: open a calculator tab from the ribbon or command palette
toggle a floating calculator usable anywhere on the desktop
perform basic arithmetic with copy and paste support
control the calculator with Windows and macOS calculator hotkeys
remember the current equation across Obsidian relaunches
extras: Supports Obsidian versions back to 0.13.30; no calculation history feature.
problem: Doing quick sums like adding up a shopping list means switching to a separate system calculator app.
summary: Standard calculator plugin that opens a sidebar or floating calculator for simple arithmetic inside Obsidian.
